about: The fallback demo's configuration, which stack.sh adds to copies of config/models.json and config/harness_profiles.json when MODELS_ENV is fallback-demo. The profile's image does not exist, so it is kept out of config/, which seeds a deployment's configuration.

tiers.name: standard
tiers.description: A feature or fix inside one module, with clear acceptance checks, or anything smaller: config, copy, a one-file edit.

tiers.name: complex
tiers.description: Cross-module changes, migrations, concurrency, security-sensitive code, or vague requirements.
